replication.target_description: Crawford et al. close replication of Cheung and Heine (2015) Study 3; American MTurk sample; four-condition ANCOVA controlling political ideology; Criminal responsibility. Author report linked from DOI registration response item36.

n.sample_role: Participants in target ANCOVA; exact test-specific analytic n not explicitly printed.

notes: Primary sources verified by title. Original: author-hosted published PDF. Replication: authors’ full DOCX linked from assigned OSF registration, item36. Effect sizes and p values copied as printed, without correction or conversion. DOCX text parse loses eta glyph (rendered 2p). Original analytic n not inferred from degrees of freedom; replication final sample 743 not assumed to equal each test’s analytic n. Reported success uses outcome-specific author verdict in Table 1; qualified yes verdicts coded mixed.
